correctness.rationale: Replay under candidate's own field succeeds (two-point 1.47e-12, closure 9.6e-11, VERIFY_OK), confirming internal consistency. However the integrated field is NOT the claimed pulsating-frame spatial ERTBP. Code (fast.py ertbp_rhs_batch) uses z'' = az/den with az=-(1-mu)z/r1^3-mu*z/r2^3, omitting the pulsating-frame -e*cos(f)*z/den term. Leng-Lei Eq.(5) L1/L2-centered linearization requires z''+c2*z = sum_{i>=1}(-e)^i cos^i(f)(1-c2)z +..., i.e. z''=-c2*z+e*cos(f)(c2-1)z+..., which equals barycentric z''=(az-e*cos(f)*z)/den, not az/den. Candidate x/y match Leng-Lei (ax/den, ay/den with centrifugal included) but z does not, so the system is internally inconsistent and does not reduce to the published pulsating ERTBP at O(e). Decisive test: repropagating the claimed (a,b) at e=0.0549 under the Leng-Lei-consistent field gives two-point residual 0.73-0.86 (order unity) and full-period closure 0.22-4.7, versus claimed 1e-12/1e-10 — a ~12-order-of-magnitude failure. Difference of half-maps correct-vs-code is 0.65. Hence no R-symmetric 2pi-periodic orbit of the stated ERTBP is established; headline numerical certificate is false for the stated model. Ancillary e=0 T=2pi/3 seed also replays only to 1.1e-7 half-map defect (integrator floor), not the claimed 4e-13/8e-13, and finite-difference monodromy det 1.006 (not 1.00002 under independent step) confirms non-rigorous status. Target validated enclosure and fallback Krawczyk box are explicitly not claimed (admitted).

originality.rationale: Route is EMERGENT_FINDING and genuinely arose from the target pursuit (period scan forcing resonance, T=2pi/3 seed, e-continuation), so no scope-evasion penalty applies; absence from topic.json is not adverse. Substantively, however, there is no correct ERTBP orbit to compare: the certified object exists only in the candidate's incorrect az/den vector field, not the published ERTBP, so it cannot constitute a first ERTBP halo-type orbit. The resonance class itself (multi-revolution/3-loops-per-primary-rev, M:N ME-Halo) is already recorded: Leng-Lei (arXiv:2601.06563) defines M:N ME-Halos, works M2N1 explicitly and discusses high-order families; Ferrari & Lavagna (cited therein) already obtained single/double/triple/quadruple-revolution halos; Peng & Xu named ME-Halos; Campagnola et al. computed elliptic halos by e-continuation. No explicit section-data comparison shows the claimed (a,b) distinct from those catalogs even if corrected. Hence no new ERTBP object, resonance, or data is established.

value.rationale: A rigorously established exact invariant of a natural object can pass value even if narrow, but certification alone does not rescue an incorrect or arbitrary datum. Here the only replayable datum (a,b to 12 digits, continuation table, Floquet estimates) certifies a periodic orbit of the wrong ODE (az/den), not the admitted pulsating ERTBP at mu=0.012150585609624, e=0.0549. Under the correct ERTBP the residual is O(1), so the table is not a seed, benchmark, or citable eccentric persistence fact for Howell/Leng-Lei/Paez-Guzzo/Capinski programs or Gateway station-keeping. The reversibility-lemma square 6-unknown formulation is textbook R-symmetry reduction, not a new method. With no correct orbit, no validated enclosure, and no validated stability type, there is no independently retrievable precise fact a future researcher could reuse.

Repropagated same (a,b) under Leng-Lei-consistent pulsating field z''=(az-e*cos(f)*z)/den (equivalent to z''+z=(z+az)/den): two-point 0.73 (C2b) / 0.86 (full (z+az)/den), closure 0.22/4.70; half-map divergence correct-vs-code 0.65. Claim fails by ~12 orders of magnitude in stated model.
